concerns.text: Task T021 implements the primary LMM using Wald‑Z statistics, whereas the specification’s acceptance scenario for FR‑003 explicitly requires significance testing via the Satterthwaite approximation. This constitutes a weakening of the functional requirement – the delivered analysis will not meet the stipulated statistical method, violating FR‑003.

Duplicate task identifiers (e.g., T090 used for weighting‑scheme definition and T090a for synthetic data generation) may cause traceability confusion across artifacts. Consider renumbering to maintain unique IDs.
